Mach Fighter Triple Breaker
■ Whenever this creature attacks, put the top card of your deck into your graveyard, then put a card from your graveyard into your mana zone.
■ When this creature is destroyed, put a creature that costs 10 or less from your mana zone into the battle zone.
Fushigiverse
